    Tuition

    Select from our live, virtual school and academic support programs. For eligible Texas families who qualify for the TEFA private school award, our Small Group Program is fully covered by the award.

    • Small Group K-12 Program

      $10,45010,450$
      Annual full-time enrollment plan for TEFA Students
      Valid for 9 months
      • Tuition may vary based on several factors
      • Email info@tcsglobal.org for International Student Pricing
      • Annual K-12 tuition per student (Small Group Classes)
      • Two-semester academic program
      • Small Group Classes for all 6 academic courses
      • Bound by our Terms of Use and Academic Contract
      • Non-cancellable and non-refundable enrollment policy
      • Tuition Contract enrollment finalized upon purchase

    • 1-on-1 K-12 Program

      $22,50022,500$
      Annual full-time enrollment plan for US K-12 Students
      Valid for 9 months
      • Email info@tcsglobal.org for International Student Pricing
      • Annual tuition per student (K-12)
      • Two-semester academic program
      • 1:1 teacher-to-student ratio for all 6 academic courses
      • Fully customized curriculum tailored to each student's needs
      • Additional tuition required for AP Courses
      • Bound by our Terms of Use and Academic Contract
      • Non-cancellable and non-refundable enrollment policy
      • Tuition Contract enrollment finalized upon purchase

    • Tutoring/Skills Course

      $2,0002,000$
      K-12 Tutoring: Language, Reading & Other Courses for US Students
      Valid for 5 months
      • Email info@tcsglobal.org for international student pricing
      • 20 hours dedicated to tutoring, skills development & support
      • 1:1 teacher-to-student ratio
      • Flexible use for K-12 curriculum tutoring
      • Bound by our Terms of Use and Academic Contract
      • Non-cancellable and non-refundable enrollment policy
      • Tuition Contract enrollment finalized upon purchase

    • One Credit Course

      $4,5004,500$
      One Credit K-12 Course for US Primary, Middle and High School Students
      Valid for 9 months
      • Email info@tcsglobal.org for international student pricing
      • 1-credit K-12 course (Primary, Middle, and High School)
      • Course duration: Two semesters
      • 1:1 teacher-to-student ratio for personalized instruction
      • Honors, AP, Dual Credit Courses require additional tuition
      • Bound by our Terms of Use and Academic Contract
      • Non-refundable and non-cancellable enrollment policy
      • Tuition Contract enrollment finalized upon purchase

    • Standardized Test Prep

      $2,5002,500$
      Test Prep for SAT, ACT, SSAT, SAT2, AP, and IB for US Students
      Valid for 5 months
      • Email info@tcsglobal.org for international student pricing
      • 20 hours dedicated to SAT, ACT, SSAT, SAT2, AP, or IB prep
      • 1:1 teacher-to-student ratio ensuring individualized support
      • Bound by our Terms of Use and Academic Contract
      • Non-refundable and non-cancelable upon enrollment
      • Tuition Contract enrollment finalized upon purchase

    TCS offers flexible, high-quality education solutions that can be purchased individually:

    ​

    • Accredited K-12 Courses – Primary, middle, and high school courses with accredited transcripts upon completion.

    • Concurrent Enrollment– Students earn dual credits through accredited courses from Syracuse University and TCS.

    • K-12 Tutoring and Skills Courses– Tutoring for all subjects and skills.

    • Test Preparation – Expert-led prep for SAT, SSAT, AP, TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, Cambridge (A-Levels), IB, and more.​

    ​

    Please email info@tcsglobal.org for more information and pricing.

    For questions, please contact info@tcsglobal.org

    Refund policy: We do not offer refunds for our services under any circumstances.
